scope: Exact WP11 case reader and its two published negative tests, alongside owned WP13 fixture/receipt changes. No whole branch intake, runtime engine change, other-branch mutation or financial-policy change.
rationale: The final WP13 candidate resolution uses cases.read and retains the candidate scenario/result rather than the complete case. The prior case reader compared version/incarnation before the last awaited authorization/evidence/operation/host callbacks, so a membership or same-version case edit in the final callback could escape that candidate comparison. The published owner fix retains the two observations and all verification passes while moving the final full-case observation after all callbacks.
newBoundaryOracles: A real cases CAS removing membership during final host revalidation suppresses the case projection even though the UI lease remains valid.
A real cases CAS changing content at the same business version suppresses the projection; a version-only fence is insufficient.
nextHostedSelection: After S12 is terminal, S14 selects the changed own source-scenario test and the new exact case-read-fence file; original budgets and all assertions retained. C17 checks the exact W17 package and guards.
evidenceBoundary: The owner review is static. The two new test cases are not accepted before hosted S14 completes. W16 S12 and earlier accepted files retain their original source/snapshot pins; no automatic current-dependency equivalence.
limits: No local product tests, typecheck, build or epic execution.
This reader fence is not an atomic observation across all foreign domains.
Installed/native consumers, positive cancellation-rule behavior and remaining required oracles remain open.
